div.div:
He was away from home for 3 years... and away from his world for 3,000 years.
3 years ago, he fell into a rift, into a world of immortals, where time flew differently. He struggled 3,000 years there to come home, only to find his family... gone. Now a 3,000-year-old monster, will he slaughter his way to the reunion, or... will he have to start all over again?
(Source: MangaToon)
Chongsheng Zhi Zui Qiang Mo Zun Zhuixu

Xuan Qiu Tuo finds a heavenly scroll that will return him to the world where he died—a world where his father reigns supreme as the Demon King. The only catch: Xuan Qiu Tuo is brought back in the body of the recently deceased Su Yun Lan. Armed with both the Heavenly Scroll and the Demonic Possession, the secret cultivation technique of the Nine Hells Clan, a new and improved Su Yun Lan is out for the King’s head and the Princess’s hand in marriage.

div.b: Your fortune: Good news will come to you by mail
